source_access_limitations: Oxford headword pages directly opened; Cambridge publisher-owned search-index results observed but direct page fetch returned HTTP 403. Search-index classifications are research leads, not independent exact-sense or human approvals.

frozen.english_definition: The Earth and all the people and places on it.
frozen.example_sentence: People around the world speak different languages.

entries.editorial_risk: Cambridge labels the Earth-and-people sense A1, below provisional A2. Oxford sense 1 is singular 'the world'; do not confuse with specialised worlds or idioms.

proposed_alternative.english_definition: The Earth, including its countries, places and people.
proposed_alternative.burmese_meaning: ကမ္ဘာမြေကြီးနှင့် ကမ္ဘာတစ်ဝန်းရှိ နိုင်ငံများ၊ နေရာများ၊ လူများ
proposed_alternative.example_sentence: Our friends live in different parts of the world.

frozen.english_definition: A person's experience of being alive.
frozen.example_sentence: Living in a new city changed her life.

entries.editorial_risk: Cambridge A1 TIME ALIVE is not automatically the frozen personal-experience sense; Oxford sense 9 supports life as a person's experiences. Do not infer a conflicting exact-sense CEFR badge.

proposed_alternative.english_definition: The experiences and activities that make up a person's life.
proposed_alternative.burmese_meaning: လူတစ်ဦး၏ ဘဝတွင် ကြုံတွေ့ဖြတ်သန်းရသော အတွေ့အကြုံများနှင့် လှုပ်ရှားမှုများ
proposed_alternative.example_sentence: Moving to another country changed her life.

frozen.english_definition: People in a community or society in general.
frozen.burmese_meaning: ပြည်သူလူထု
frozen.example_sentence: The library is open to the public.

entries.editorial_risk: Cambridge indexes the noun 'the public' at B1, above provisional A2. Oxford People in society a2 is a topic label, not a headword exact-sense CEFR badge. Frozen example correctly uses 'the public'.

proposed_alternative.english_definition: Ordinary people in society, considered together.
proposed_alternative.burmese_meaning: အများပြည်သူ၊ လူထုတစ်ရပ်လုံး
proposed_alternative.example_sentence: The new park is open to the public.

frozen.english_definition: Information collected for study or use.
frozen.burmese_meaning: စုဆောင်းထားသော အချက်အလက်များ
frozen.example_sentence: The team checked the data before writing the report.

entries.editorial_risk: Cambridge labels collected facts/information B2, above provisional A2. Oxford documents mass/plural treatment and British pronunciations /ˈdeɪtə/ and /ˈdɑːtə/; require one chosen George/Emma target and actual listening.

proposed_alternative.english_definition: Facts or information collected so that they can be studied or used to make decisions.
proposed_alternative.burmese_meaning: လေ့လာဆန်းစစ်ရန် သို့မဟုတ် ဆုံးဖြတ်ချက်ချရန် စုဆောင်းထားသော အချက်အလက်များ
proposed_alternative.example_sentence: The researchers checked the data before writing their report.

frozen.english_definition: The public service whose officers enforce the law and protect people.
frozen.example_sentence: The police asked drivers to use another road.

entries.editorial_risk: Cambridge A2 alignment lead. British plural agreement: 'The police are', not 'The police is'. Oxford Law and justice a1 is a topic label, not proof of a headword A1 badge.

proposed_alternative.english_definition: The organisation and officers responsible for enforcing the law and protecting people.
proposed_alternative.burmese_meaning: ဥပဒေစိုးမိုးရေးနှင့် ပြည်သူများ၏ လုံခြုံရေးအတွက် တာဝန်ယူသော ရဲတပ်ဖွဲ့
proposed_alternative.example_sentence: The police are investigating the accident.

frozen.english_definition: An institution where people study for degrees and conduct research.
frozen.example_sentence: My sister studies engineering at university.

entries.editorial_risk: Cambridge A1 degree institution conflicts with provisional A2. Oxford directly supports British 'at university' without an article, contrasting with US 'in college'.

proposed_alternative.english_definition: A place of higher education where students study for degrees and may carry out research.
proposed_alternative.burmese_meaning: ဘွဲ့ရရှိရန် အဆင့်မြင့်ပညာသင်ကြားပြီး သုတေသနလုပ်နိုင်သည့် တက္ကသိုလ်
proposed_alternative.example_sentence: My brother is studying at university.
